name: Solitaire
tagline: Klondike on a phone. The file is the tableau.
description:
Seven columns, four foundations, a three-card waste. Red on black, black on red, kings in empty spaces, aces up the foundations. Tap a face-up card and it jumps to the first legal home. Drag works too, with a mouse or a finger.

Close it and come back — the tableau is where you left it, inside this copy of the app. New game shuffles a fresh deck.

An unofficial port of js-solitaire by rjanjic. Same Klondike rules; cards drawn in CSS so it fits a phone.
